The markdown file is to run the saved results from the CRM simulation R file with the following priors:
log(ID70) ~ N(4, 0.8^2), truncated to (3,7)
log(a) ~ Unif(log(0.3), log(0.8))

Decision rules are as follows: 
  
1. If ID70 is more than 2 log10 units above the current dose, we escalate the next dose by 2 log10 units. Move on to the next check if this is not met.

2. We look at the proportion of infection probability at the current dose that exceeds 0.6, if the percentage is lower than 75%, escalate by one log10 unit, otherwise, move on to the next check.

3. Now look at the proportion of infection probability at the current dose that exceeds 0.8, if the percentage is higher than 95%, de-escalate by one log10 unit.

4. If any of the conditions are not met above, maintain the current dose for the next cohrot.

We are taking the mean of posterior probabilities to see if the proportion exceeds 0.6/0.8 as stated above. 

```{r}
library(rstan)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(magick)
library(truncnorm)
library(cowplot)

```

```{r}
set.seed(42)
n_sims <- 1000
doses <- seq(10^4, 10^9, by=10000)
dose_grid <- 10^seq(1, 9, length.out = 101)

beta_poisson <- function(dose, a, b) {
  1 - (1 + dose/b)^-a
}

log_a <- runif(n_sims, log(0.3), log(0.8))
log10_id70 <- rtruncnorm(
  n_sims, a = 3, b = 7, mean = 4, sd = 0.8
)
a = exp(log_a)
id70 <- 10^log10_id70

prior_data_3 <- data.frame(
  sim = 1:n_sims,
  a = a,
  b = id70 / (0.3^(-1 / a) - 1)
)

# generate probabilities for each dose level
plot_data_3 <- prior_data_3 %>%
  group_by(sim) %>%
  do(data.frame(dose=dose_grid, prob = beta_poisson(dose_grid, .$a, .$b)))

# Calculate the 95% Credible Interval (Ribbon Data)
# group by dose to find the range of 'prob' across all 1000 sims
cri_data <- plot_data_3 %>%
  group_by(dose) %>%
  summarise(
    lower = quantile(prob, 0.025),
    median = quantile(prob, 0.50),
    upper = quantile(prob, 0.975),
    Q1 = quantile(prob, 0.25),
    Q3 = quantile(prob, 0.75)
  )
```


```{r}
plot_aggregated_curve_with_points <- function(example_posterior, one_sim_points, id70, prior_band, true_prior) {
  
  img_url = c()
  plot_dir <- "plots/example posterior sim"
  
  shared_legend <- NULL
  
  for (cohort_i in sort(unique(one_sim_points$cohort))) {
  
  
    df_cohort <- example_posterior %>%
      filter(cohort == cohort_i)
  
    # keep points observed up to this cohort
    pts <- one_sim_points %>%
      filter(cohort <= !!cohort_i) 
    
    # collapse duplicate point locations into one label
    pts_lab <- pts %>%
    group_by(current_dose, prob) %>%
    summarise(
      label = paste(cohort, collapse = ","),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
    
    # ID70 summary for this cohort
    id70_df <- id70 %>%
      filter(cohort == !!cohort_i)
    
    p <- ggplot(df_cohort, aes(x = dose, y = mean)) +
      # 95% credible intervals for the posterior curve
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper,
                      fill = "Posterior dose-response 95% CrI"),
                  alpha = 0.25
                  ) +
      
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q1, ymax = q3,
                      fill = "Posterior dose-response 50% CrI"),
                  alpha = 0.25
                  ) +
    
      # 95% ID70 range as vertical band
      geom_rect(
        data = id70_df,
        aes(xmin = id70_lower, xmax = id70_upper, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
            fill = "Posterior ID70 95% CrI"),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        alpha = 0.2
      ) +
      
      # dashed line for 95% prior interval to contrast the posterior shrinking
      geom_line(
        data = prior_band,
        aes(x = dose, y = lower,
            color = "Prior 95% CrI"),
        linetype = "dashed",
        linewidth = 0.5
      ) +
      
      geom_line(
        data = prior_band,
        aes(x = dose, y = upper,
            color = "Prior 95% CrI"),
        linetype = "dashed",
        linewidth = 0.5
      ) +
      
      # points for observation
      geom_point(
        data = pts,
        aes(x = current_dose, y = prob),
        color = "black",
        size = 2.5,
        inherit.aes = FALSE
      ) +
      
      geom_text(
        data = pts_lab,
        aes(x = current_dose, y = prob, label = label),
        nudge_y = 0.04,
        size = 4,
        inherit.aes = FALSE
      ) +
      
      # horizontal line at 0.7
      geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 0.70, color = "70% infection"), 
                 linewidth = 0.4) +
      
      geom_hline(
        aes(yintercept = 0.60,
          color = "60-80% infection"),
        linetype = "dashed",
        linewidth = 0.2
      ) +
      
      geom_hline(
        aes(yintercept = 0.80,
          color = "60-80% infection"),
        linetype = "dashed",
        linewidth = 0.2
      ) +
      
      # true prior curve
      geom_line(
        data = true_prior,
        aes(x = dose, y = prob,
            color = "True prior dose-response"),
        linetype = "solid",
        linewidth = 0.5
      ) +
      
      scale_x_log10(
        breaks = 10^(1:9),               # Sets ticks at each power of 10
        labels = function(x) log10(x)    # Converts 10, 100, 1000 -> 1, 2, 3
      ) +
      
      scale_color_manual(
        values = c(
          "Prior 95% CrI" = "blue",
          "True prior dose-response" = "black",
          "70% infection" = "red",
          "60-80% infection" = "red"
        )) +

      scale_fill_manual(
        values = c(
          "Posterior dose-response 95% CrI" = "steelblue",
          "Posterior dose-response 50% CrI" = "blue",
          "Posterior ID70 95% CrI" = "gray46"
        )) +
      
      coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.05)) +
      
      labs(
        title = paste("Example posterior curve after Cohort", cohort_i),
        x = expression("Dose (" * log[10] ~ "CFU)"),
        y = "Probability of infection"
      ) +
      
      theme_bw() +
      
      guides(
        fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
        color = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
      ) +
      
      theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 13),
        legend.key.width = unit(1.8, "cm"),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.6, "cm"),
        legend.spacing.x = unit(0.6, "cm"),
        legend.spacing.y = unit(0.3, "cm"),
        legend.box = "vertical",
        legend.box.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
      )
    
    # extract legend only once
    if (is.null(shared_legend)) {
      shared_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(p)
    }
    
    # remove legend from individual plots
    p_nolegend <- p +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none"
      )
    
    # saving the individual plots to the designated folder
    file_name <- paste0("aggregated_posterior_with_points_cohort_", cohort_i, ".png")
    full_path <- file.path(plot_dir, file_name)
    
    ggsave(
        filename = file_name,
        path = plot_dir,
        plot = p_nolegend,
        width = 6,
        height = 4
      )
    
    # Append the path to our list
    img_url <- c(img_url, full_path)
    
  }
  
  # read cohort plots
  imgs <- image_read(img_url)
  
  # create montage first to preserve original cohort plot sizing
  # but add a blank sixth panel
  panel_info <- image_info(imgs[1])
  panel_width <- panel_info$width
  panel_height <- panel_info$height
  
  blank_panel <- image_blank(
    width = panel_width,
    height = panel_height,
    color = "white"
  )
  
  # save shared legend
  legend_path <- file.path(plot_dir, "shared_legend.png")
  
  ggsave(
    filename = legend_path,
    plot = cowplot::plot_grid(shared_legend),
    width = 7,
    height = 3
  )
  
  # read and shrink legend
  legend_img <- image_read(legend_path)
  
  #
  legend_img <- image_resize(
    legend_img,
    paste0(round(panel_width * 0.95), "x", round(panel_height * 1.1))
  )
  
  # center legend inside blank panel
  legend_info <- image_info(legend_img)
  
  x_offset <- round((panel_width - legend_info$width) / 2)
  y_offset <- round((panel_height - legend_info$height) / 2)
  
  legend_panel <- image_composite(
    blank_panel,
    legend_img,
    offset = paste0("+", x_offset, "+", y_offset)
  )
  
  # add legend panel as the 6th image
  imgs_with_legend <- c(imgs, legend_panel)
  
  final_with_legend <- image_montage(
    imgs_with_legend,
    tile = "2x3",
    geometry = paste0(panel_width, "x", panel_height, "+10+10"),
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  
  # Save the final montage
  image_write(final_with_legend, "plots/example posterior sim/combined_cohort_plots_with_decision.png", format = 'png')
  
}
```



loading the simulated results again so we can report the results 
```{r}
setwd('simulation result/old decision rule')

all_posteriors <- read.csv("posterior_sim_result_3.csv")
all_paths_df <- read.csv("all_paths_3.csv")
id70_df <- read.csv("id70_3.csv")
```


The code below is to produce posterior plots for one of the simulation as an example to illustrate how the updates of posterior after each cohort and also the decision rules that were implemented (ie. how the escalation and de-escalation work for this example)

The plot involves 50% and 95% credible intervals for the posterior dose-response model, as well as 95% interval for ID70 in each cohort
```{r}

# get results from simulation 1 to check if decision rules were correctly executed
one_sim_points <- all_paths_df %>%
  filter(sim_id == 1)

example_posterior <- all_posteriors %>% 
    filter(sim_id == 1)

example_id70 <- id70_df %>%
    filter(sim_id == 1)

# getting the true prior for the example to be included in the plot
set.seed(42)
dose_grid <- 10^seq(1, 9, length.out = 101)
true_log10_id70 <- rtruncnorm(1, a = 3, b = 7, mean = 4, sd = 0.8)
true_log_a <- runif(1, log(0.3), log(0.8))
  
true_a <- exp(true_log_a)
true_id70 <- 10^true_log10_id70
true_b <- true_id70 / (0.3^(-1/true_a) - 1)
true_p <- p_inf(dose_grid, true_a, true_b)

true_prior <- data.frame(
  dose = dose_grid,
  prob = true_p
)

plot_aggregated_curve_with_points(example_posterior, one_sim_points, example_id70, cri_data, true_prior)

```



```{r}
id70_summary_by_cohort <- id70_df %>%
  group_by(cohort) %>%
  summarise(
    id70_mean = log10(mean(mean)),
    id70_median = log10(median(mean)),
    id70_sd = log10(sd(mean)),
    id70_lo = log10(quantile(mean, 0.025)),
    id70_hi = log10(quantile(mean, 0.975)),
    id70_q1 = log10(quantile(mean, 0.25)),
    id70_q3 = log10(quantile(mean, 0.75)),
    n_trials = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

id70_summary_by_cohort
```

The average total number of participants (sample size required) across 1000 simulations 
```{r}

final_trial <- all_paths_df %>%
  group_by(sim_id) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = cohort, n=1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(total_enrolled = cohort * 5, 
         final_log10_dose = log10(current_dose))

final_trial <- final_trial %>% 
  left_join(true_param, by = "sim_id") %>%
  mutate(
    dose_error =
      final_log10_dose - true_log10_id70,

    abs_dose_error =
      abs(dose_error),

    squared_dose_error =
      dose_error^2
  )

```


```{r}
paths_summary <- final_trial %>%
  summarise(
    mean_total_sample_size = mean(total_enrolled),
    quantile_95_sample_size = quantile(total_enrolled, 0.95),
    median_number_of_cohort = median(cohort),
    median_final_CRM_recommended_dose = log10(median(current_dose)),
    mean_absolute_bias = mean(abs_dose_error),
    mean_RMSE = sqrt(mean(dose_error^2))
  )

paths_summary
```

```{r}
final_trial %>% 
  summarise(
    full_trial = sum(total_enrolled == 35, na.rm = TRUE),
    stop_early = sum(total_enrolled != 35, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r,fig.width=16, fig.height=6}
final_id_70 <- id70_df %>%
  group_by(sim_id) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = cohort, n=1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    log10_id70_mean = log10(mean),
    log10_id70_lower = log10(id70_lower), 
    log10_id70_upper = log10(id70_upper), 
  ) %>%
  left_join(true_param, by = "sim_id") %>%
  mutate(
    coverage = ifelse(
      true_log10_id70 >= log10_id70_lower &
      true_log10_id70 <= log10_id70_upper,
      "Covered", "Not covered"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(log10_id70_mean) %>%
  mutate(sim_order = row_number())

p <- ggplot(final_id_70, aes(x = sim_order)) +

  # 95% posterior credible intervals
  geom_linerange(
    aes(
      ymin = log10_id70_lower,
      ymax = log10_id70_upper
    ),
    colour = "grey65",
    alpha = 0.25,
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +

  # Posterior mean
  geom_line(
    aes(y = log10_id70_mean),
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  # True ID70 values
  geom_point(
    aes(
      y = true_log10_id70,
      colour = coverage
    ),
    size = 0.35,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Covered" = "#2C7BB6",
      "Not covered" = "#D7191C"
    )
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 1000, 200),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Simulation (ordered by posterior mean)",
    y = expression(log[10](ID70)),
    colour = "True ID70"
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +

  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )

p2 <- ggplot(final_id_70, aes(x = sim_order)) +

  # 95% posterior credible intervals
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = log10_id70_lower,
      ymax = log10_id70_upper
    ),
    fill = "grey75",
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +

  # Posterior mean
  geom_line(
    aes(y = log10_id70_mean),
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  # True ID70 values
  geom_point(
    aes(
      y = true_log10_id70,
      colour = coverage
    ),
    size = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Covered" = "#2C7BB6",
      "Not covered" = "#D7191C"
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Simulation (ordered by posterior mean)",
    y = expression(log[10](ID70)),
    colour = "True ID70"
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +

  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

p2
```

```{r, fig.width=16, fig.height=6}
final_id_70_error <- final_id_70 %>%
  mutate(
    error_mean = log10_id70_mean - true_log10_id70,
    error_lower = log10_id70_lower - true_log10_id70,
    error_upper = log10_id70_upper - true_log10_id70)
  # ) %>%
  # arrange(error_mean) %>%
  # mutate(sim_order = row_number())

p3 <- ggplot(final_id_70_error, aes(x = sim_id)) +

  geom_linerange(
    aes(
      ymin = error_lower,
      ymax = error_upper,
      colour = coverage
    ),
    alpha = 0.4,
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +

  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Covered" = "#2C7BB6",
      "Not covered" = "#D7191C"
    )
  ) +
  
  guides(
  colour = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(
      linewidth = 2,
      alpha = 1
      )
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Simulation (ordered by estimation error)",
    y = expression(
      log[10](ID70[posterior]) -
      log[10](ID70[true])
    ),
    colour = "Coverage"
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +

  theme(
    # X and Y axis titles
  axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),

  # X and Y axis tick labels
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),

  # Legend title and labels
  legend.title = element_text(size = 15),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 14),

  # Legend position
  legend.position = "bottom",

  # Legend spacing
  legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm")
  )

ggsave("plots/prior_predictive_posterior_ID70coverage.pdf", p3,
       width = 16, height = 6)
```

```{r}
start3_final_trial <- start3_all_paths_df %>%
  group_by(sim_id) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = cohort, n=1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(total_enrolled = cohort * 5)

start3_paths_summary <- start3_final_trial %>%
  summarise(
    mean_total_sample_size = mean(total_enrolled),
    quantile_95_sample_size = quantile(total_enrolled, 0.95),
    median_number_of_cohort = median(cohort),

  )
```
